# AdyDaddy - Full Site Content

AdyDaddy is a performance marketing agency. Marketing that's judged on revenue, not reach.

## Home

AdyDaddy plans, builds, and scales paid media, SEO, and content programs for D2C and growth-stage brands, scoping every engagement against payback, not vanity metrics.

Key numbers: 1.8x average blended ROAS lift, 4.1x average organic traffic growth, ₹2Cr+ ad spend managed monthly, 94% client retention.

How we work: Diagnose, Scope, Scale, Report.

## Services

### Performance Marketing
We run performance marketing as a revenue function, not a media-buying checklist. Every campaign is scoped against a payback target before a single rupee is spent, structured for fast, statistically sound testing, and reviewed weekly against the number that actually matters: profitable revenue.
Deliverables: full-funnel Meta and Google Ads management, creative testing pipeline, landing page and offer experimentation, server-side tracking and attribution, weekly reporting.

### SEO + AEO / GEO
SEO only works as a compounding asset if it's treated as one. We start with a technical foundation audit, build a content architecture around real search demand and AI-answer-engine visibility, and back it with a link and authority plan that survives algorithm updates.
Deliverables: technical SEO audit and fix roadmap, keyword and topic cluster strategy, on-page and content optimization, AI Overviews / GEO visibility, authority and digital PR link building.

### Social Media Marketing
Organic social is where brand demand gets created before paid media ever captures it. We build content systems, not one-off posts, across the platforms your audience actually spends time on, and pair them with creator and community strategy.
Deliverables: platform strategy and content pillars, short-form video production, community management, creator and influencer partnerships, monthly reporting.

### Content & Creative
Creative is the biggest lever in paid media performance, so we run it in-house and iterate on it like a testing program: hooks, formats, and angles are ranked by actual click-through and conversion data, not internal opinion.
Deliverables: static and video ad creative, UGC-style content direction, brand identity and design systems, landing page design, creative performance tracking.

### Marketing Automation & CRM
The highest-margin revenue in most businesses comes from customers who already trust you. We build lifecycle email, SMS, and CRM automation that turns first purchases into repeat ones: segmented, tested, and reported against retained revenue, not open rates alone.
Deliverables: lifecycle email and SMS flow builds, CRM segmentation and scoring, campaign calendar and execution, retention and LTV reporting.

### Conversion Rate Optimization
The fastest way to grow profitably is often to fix the funnel you already have. We run structured CRO: heuristic audits, session recordings, and prioritized A/B tests, so every extra visitor converts at a higher rate.
Deliverables: funnel and heuristic audits, A/B and multivariate testing, landing page rebuilds, checkout and form optimization.

### Website Development & Management
Your store is where paid traffic either converts or dies. We design, build, and manage high-converting Shopify stores and marketing sites, then keep improving them with the same CRO discipline we apply to your ads.
Deliverables: Shopify store design and build, landing page development, theme customization and speed optimization, ongoing maintenance, conversion-focused redesigns.

## Results

Founder track record: $50M lifetime ad spend managed, 20+ brands scaled, 12K+ customers in retention engine, 3 affiliate verticals cracked.

Brands worked with: Joules by Radhika, Prisho, Nidhika Shekhar, Varoin Marwah, House of Ksara, Seeaash, Nouria Design, Ambrosia India, The Dramebaaz Co, Tahvo India, Nautanky India, Aakriti by Nandita, Bajaao, Austin Bazaar, Urban Hive, myTVS, Sitarah, Araq by Arwa, Negra Elegante, and more.

## About

AdyDaddy was started by Vibhor Sharma, a performance marketer who scaled multiple D2C brands before opening the agency. The team plans, builds, and scales paid media, SEO, and content programs for D2C and growth-stage brands, scoping every engagement against payback.

## Frequently asked questions

What kinds of brands do you work with? Mostly D2C and growth-stage e-commerce brands doing ₹10L to ₹5Cr/month in revenue, though we also take on select B2B and app-based clients where performance marketing is a core growth lever.

Do you require long-term contracts? We work on a 3-month initial engagement so there's enough runway to test and show results, then move to month-to-month. No long lock-ins beyond that.

How is reporting handled? You get a live dashboard plus a written weekly summary and a monthly strategy call, always tied to revenue and payback, not just platform metrics.

Can you work alongside our in-house marketing team? Yes, we regularly work as an extension of in-house teams, either owning specific channels or acting as a strategic layer on top of execution you already have.

What does working with you cost? We work on a monthly retainer plus a performance component tied to results, sized to your growth stage and scope.

How quickly can we get started? Most engagements kick off within one to two weeks once we've aligned on scope and you've granted account access.
